job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: This is a 2024 City of Baltimore BCERS alternatives-consultant RFP, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS private-equity-consulting RFP. Its proposal deadline cannot establish the deadline for the Hawaii RFP.
quotes: THE EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM and OPEB TRUST – CITY OF BALTIMORE REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) for ALTERNATIVES CONSULTANT
Proposals must be received no later than 3:00 P.M. EDT, November 8, 2024.
